title: Japan Crate Alternatives: 5 Boxes Like Japan Crate - Cratejoy
summary: Compare five boxes like Japan Crate, from Japan-only candy and traditional snacks to kawaii goods, Japanese stationery, and designer toys.
body_markdown:
## The alternatives


The original Japan Crate


### TokyoTreat vs Japan Crate


**Best for:** The Japan Crate fan who’s in it for the Kit Kat flavors they can’t buy at home.


[TokyoTreat](https://tokyotreat.com/subscribe) builds each month’s box around a theme, such as Halloween or the Sakura Festival, and ships it from Japan. Expect 12 to 15 full-size snacks from brands like Kit Kat, Pocky, Hi-Chew, and Calbee, many in Japan-only flavors, with instant noodles or a capsule toy in some months.


#### What feels familiar


Pop-culture candy, DIY candy kits, and a 20-page booklet that explains the snacks the way Japan Crate’s manga-zine did.


#### What changes


The box holds fewer snacks than Japan Crate’s 18 to 20, and a drink isn’t part of the promise. The monthly plan is $37.50, and U.S. shipping and import duty add $22.24 a box.


For traditional snacks and tea


### Bokksu Snack Box vs Japan Crate


**Best for:** The snacker who wants allergen information and the story behind each snack.


[Bokksu](https://www.bokksu.com/products/classic-bokksu) fills its snack box with treats from small family-run makers in Japan. The first box holds 22 snacks, candies, and a tea, and a 22- to 24-page guide covers where each snack comes from and lists allergens.


#### What feels familiar


A full box of Japanese snacks every month, shipped from Japan, with a guide to read alongside it.


#### What changes


Pop candy gives way to senbei rice crackers, cakes, and mochi, plus a new tea each month, from matcha to hojicha. The monthly plan is $39.99, and U.S. shipping and duty add $16.99 a box. Monthly subscribers can skip a box from their account.


For Doki Doki Crate fans


### Kawaii Mystery Box From Japan vs Japan Crate


1st box


50% off


Best New Box 2024


[Kawaii Mystery Box From Japan!](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/kawaii-mystery-box-hinachansjapanmysteryboxshop) by Hinachan’s Japan Mystery Box Shop


From $54.95 / box


Ships fast


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/kawaii-mystery-box-hinachansjapanmysteryboxshop)


**Best for:** The Doki Doki Crate fan who loves plushies and cute goods arriving from Japan.


Hinachan’s Japan Mystery Box Shop fills each box by hand from kawaii shops all over Japan. The seller says every box includes plushies, accessories, and kawaii home decor, and some add character goods, stationery, stickers, or memo pads. You pick the size, from 2 to 4 items up to 15 to 20.


#### What feels familiar


A monthly surprise of cute goods sent from Japan, with free express shipping.


#### What changes


Doki Doki Crate sent 5 or 6 licensed items. The closest size here is the M box, 5 to 7 items for $70 a month, and a 3-month plan takes $5 off each box.


For Inku Crate fans


### The Stationery Selection vs Japan Crate


**Best for:** The Inku Crate fan who wants a surprise stack of Japanese stationery every month.


[The Stationery Selection](https://thestationeryselection.com/collections/stationery-boxes) runs a stationery shop in Tokyo, and its subscription sends a box of stationery from Japan every month. Boxes are billed on the 20th and ship around the turn of the month.


#### What feels familiar


A box you don’t pick yourself, filled with Japanese stationery and mailed from Japan, the way Inku Crate came.


#### What changes


The box is $34.95 a month, and shipping is extra. One U.S. option, $12.49 a month, ships two months of boxes together every other month, and any customs charges are collected on delivery. The shop asks subscribers to stay for at least two boxes before canceling.


For Gacha Gacha Crate fans


### Mystery Toy Box vs Japan Crate


[Mystery Toy Box](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/mysterytoybox) by Mystery Toy Box by Mindzai


From $41.99 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/mysterytoybox)


**Best for:** The capsule-toy collector who loves never knowing which figure will turn up.


Mindzai packs 5 to 8 toys a month from designer toy brands such as POP MART, Medicom Toy, tokidoki, Kidrobot, Funko, and Superplastic, and promises never to send the same toy twice.


#### What feels familiar


A monthly pile of small surprise figures to open, sort, and line up on a shelf.


#### What changes


These are designer toys, not gachapon from capsule machines in Japan, and the box ships from the US. Boxes go out on the 15th, so order by the 1st to get that month’s box.
